module: Flowgraph node "Get Clouds" (category repeat_instant, tags environment/weather/cloud). Reads the parameters of a cloud object via core_environment. Input: objectId (number, optional). Outputs: coverage (sky coverage), exposure (brightness), windSpeed (texture scroll speed), height (height). Without objectId, uses the default clouds: only coverage (getCloudCover) and windSpeed (getWindSpeed) are available, exposure and height are 0.

work.desc: Every frame, fills the outputs from core_environment (getCloud*ByID if objectId, otherwise default values).
